backend/main.mo: Defines core actor types and state for user profiles, rituals, pairing, love languages, challenges, storage, and authorization mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence entries mapping implemented features to affected files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides prewritten short summaries for many frontend files covering UI pages, components, hooks, and styling.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base setup defining OKLCH design tokens, light/dark theme variables, and global background/foreground styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with meta tags, theme color, viewport settings, and script loading for the React app.
frontend/QA_ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md: Manual QA checklist detailing test cases for authentication, themes, pairing, rituals, and feature behaviors.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app logic handling authentication, profile setup, tab navigation, and themed UI via ThemeProvider.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Renders a fixed bottom navigation bar with icons and labels, highlighting the active tab and invoking tab changes on click.
frontend/src/components/CompletionAnimat: Displays floating heart animations using generated positions and delays for a completion effect.
frontend/src/components/DataStates.tsx: Provides reusable UI components for loading, empty, error, and section header states with optional actions and details.
frontend/src/components/HarmonyBreakdown: Shows current harmony score, trend analysis, and a 7‑day sparkline, with conditional explanations and data checks.
Compact harmony summary button showing current percentage and trend, navigating to insights on click.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Handles login/logout via Internet Identity, showing loading and status icons and clearing query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/LoveChallenges.t: Static card announcing upcoming love challenges with decorative icons and placeholder text.
frontend/src/components/OurLoveLanguages: Card showing love‑language status with primary and secondary actions, optional highlight animation, and loading state.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Form for initializing a user profile with name input, error handling, and a brief success animation before callback.
frontend/src/components/RewardVisuals.ts: Displays placeholder progress visuals including a heart-shaped meter and milestone icons for challenge tracking.
frontend/src/components/SpinWheel.tsx: Implements a spinning wheel that selects a random love language, with animations, easing, and daily spin persistence.
frontend/src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx: Provides a button to toggle between light and dark themes using the theme context.
frontend/src/components/UnlockPacks.tsx: Renders unlockable love‑language activity packs gated by streak requirements and user quiz completion.
frontend/src/contexts/ThemeContext.tsx: Manages theme state, syncing with system preference and localStorage, and exposes a toggle via context.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to the user’s identity, updating and invalidating queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Handles Internet Identity login, stored identity loading, logout, and status tracking through a React context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides numerous React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user, admin, pairing, ritual, quiz, and insights data through the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Re-exports the useTheme hook from the ThemeContext for backwards compatibility.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global styles, Tailwind layers, color variables, dark mode overrides, and custom animations for the app’s UI theme.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/Activities.tsx: Renders the Activities page, showing love challenges, rewards, and interactive features based on user pairing, admin status, and quiz state.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Implements the Home page with daily ritual flow, history display, photo upload, and love language–based UI interactions.
frontend/src/pages/Insights.tsx: Displays user relationship insights, streaks, trends, badges, and quiz-based harmony metrics using backend-driven analytics.
frontend/src/pages/LoveLanguages.tsx: Implements the love languages quiz UI, including questions, scoring, and saving or resetting results through backend hooks.
frontend/src/pages/Memories.tsx: Displays a list of ritual memory entries with date formatting, love language tags, and expandable response sections with photos.
frontend/src/pages/Us.tsx: Manages pairing flow, profile checks, admin state, and renders shared love language insights for the couple.
frontend/src/utils/harmony.ts: Provides helper functions for converting harmony scores, normalizing trend data, and generating trend labels and display metadata.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Handles reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters for routing and state management.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme settings, colors, fonts, animations, and content scanning for the frontend.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s schema/version and lists implemented features of the GrowInLove app, covering authentication, access control, user profiles, UI shell, theming, and partner-based workflows. Provides short descriptions, synonyms, and versions for each feature.
